result.summary: The page is mostly clean and well-structured. The main visual defect is the promo banner, where white text sits on a very light mint background and is nearly unreadable. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off bottom card were excluded as intended features.

issues.description: The promo banner's heading '3 free deliveries for you' and its subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are white on a very light mint green background. The contrast is far below WCAG AA, so the offer and promo code are hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Use dark text (such as the dark green or near-black used elsewhere) for the banner heading and subtext, or darken the banner background so white text meets at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

issues.description: The light gray delivery fee and time metadata under the restaurant cards (e.g., '€0.90 delivery') is fairly faint on white, which slightly reduces legibility.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color slightly to improve contrast while keeping the visual hierarchy.
